message.content:
It’s hard to pick just one “best” film because tastes vary so much, but if you’re looking for a standout from 2020 that received widespread acclaim and awards buzz, **“Parasite”** (though technically a 2019 release) still dominated many year‑end lists and won the Academy Award for Best Picture in early 2021. If you want something strictly released in 2020, consider:

| Film | Director | Why it stood out |
|------|----------|------------------|
| *Tenet* | Christopher Nolan | A mind‑bending sci‑fi thriller that pushed the limits of practical effects and narrative structure. |
| *Soul* | Pete Docter & Kemp Powers | Pixar’s heartfelt exploration of purpose and passion, winning the Oscar for Best Animated Feature. |
| *1917* | Sam Mendes | A war epic shot to look like a single continuous take, praised for its immersive cinematography. |
| *Nomadland* | Chloé Zhao | A quiet, poetic portrait of modern American nomads, winning Best Picture at the Golden Globes. |

If you have a particular genre in mind—action, drama, animation—I can narrow down the recommendation further!
